Iconic EQ Shotgun (w/ Kinetic Absorption [BODY requirements reduced by 3], Power Rebuild, & Shotgun Short Barrel). Holds 12 rounds. Fired using the Handgun Skill. Has Autofire (Machine Pistol 4). Requires BODY 5+ or a Cyberarm to fire without suffering the Torn Muscle Critical Injury. Requires BODY 7+ or a Cyberarm to fire in Autofire without suffering the Broken Arm Critical Injury. Can accept an additional Weapon Mod (1 Total, as it already has Kinetic Absorption).

Variant of: Pozhar
Category: Luxury
Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
Class: Shotgun
Range: Short Barrel Shotgun
Pre-installed: Power Rebuild (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4), Shotgun Shell

Foundry notes:

  • CPR 0.92.4 shows a "weapon doesn't support this mode" warning when a pistol Autofires; it's only a warning and the roll still works.
  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).
  • Iconic: it can't be bought or sourced on the street, can't be fabricated without its Blueprint, can't be taken during Character Generation, and once acquired can't be destroyed unless the player agrees to it beforehand.
  • The price is the Luxury benchmark, for working out repairs and Tech Upgrades. Iconics can't be bought.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Becoming Iconic > Iconic Weapons).
